claims: Bruce Lee and Chuck Norris were real-life friends.
Bruce Lee and Chuck Norris trained together before filming their fight scene in the 1972 movie "Way of the Dragon".
"Way of the Dragon" is also known as "Return of the Dragon".
The fight scene in "Way of the Dragon" took place in Rome's Colosseum.
Bruce Lee and Chuck Norris were friends and training partners in the 1960s.
Bruce Lee sought out Chuck Norris for his film.
"Way of the Dragon" was released in 1972.
"Way of the Dragon" was the only film Bruce Lee and Chuck Norris appeared in together.
In "Way of the Dragon", Bruce Lee played Tang Lung.
In "Way of the Dragon", Chuck Norris played Colt.
In "Way of the Dragon", Tang Lung defeats Colt.
The showdown in "Way of the Dragon" was filmed in the Roman Colosseum.
The production of "Way of the Dragon" shot illegally on-site at the Roman Colosseum.
Chuck Norris agreed to play the villain in "Way of the Dragon".
Chuck Norris agreed to lose in "Way of the Dragon" because of his respect for Bruce Lee.
Chuck Norris weighed about 186lbs during filming of "Way of the Dragon".
Chuck Norris was a major champion.
Tweets from X users say Norris's weight and championship brought realism to the fight in "Way of the Dragon".
